name: RiskCube
long_description:
RiskCube enables venture-backed startups to close enterprise deals with top-rated insurance. We offer everything startups need on their insurance journey—from D&O, cyber liability, E&O, and general liability to health, benefits, and life insurance.

Mission: Building insurance products & services focused on lowering the protection gap for the innovation economy on a national and global scale. 

One example is the emerging AI data supply chain. Data vendors sourcing, processing, and licensing data to leading AI labs face complex liability exposures, including wrongful collection of personal data, intellectual property infringement, and unauthorized disclosure. Traditional insurance policies often exclude or inadequately address these risks, creating protection gaps for both data vendors and their enterprise customers.
one_liner: AI commercial insurance brokerage for startups.
